Evolving wheel prize lists

Tier 1 starts on the wheel. Each claimed position fills from Tier 2, then Bonus. Prize amounts cannot exceed their tier's budget. Editing already-won prizes is blocked until a new game.

Import a V5 browser configuration

The older game stored prizes and music in one browser. You can import its Tier 1, Tier 2, and Bonus prize definitions here. This does not erase the old browser copy. Existing claimed prizes are imported into a separate completed historical session, never into an active game. Duplicate imports of the same game are blocked.
